notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
Dear players!

The names of characters, guilds, and pets belonging to inactive characters will be released. All affected characters will receive Character Rename Scrolls. If a pet has been renamed, a Pet Rename Scroll will be issued. In the case of a guild rename, the corresponding scrolls will be granted to the guild master.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
Dear players!

Changes have been made to the game. Now, when creating or renaming, the following restrictions apply:

⭐Character name (Cyrillic/Latin) — no more than 12 characters.
⭐Guild name (Latin only) — no more than 12 characters.
⭐Pet name (Cyrillic or Latin) — no more than 12 characters.

We wish you a pleasant game!

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
Dear players!
As you know, our beloved game supports many languages since it is played by people from all over the world.
Unfortunately, some of you may have previously noticed strange symbols in chat instead of text in other languages.
We have fixed this issue — the chat should now display messages correctly, without mysterious "elvish" characters.

Enjoy the game!
